typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BOOK_ID as decimal(38,0),
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		LOCATION as string,
		ACTIVITY as string,
		ACCOUNTINGLINK as string,
		BASE_CURRENCY as string,
		BUSINESSTYPE as string,
		PROFITCENTER as string,
		OPICSLBOOK as string,
		OPICSSPOTBOOK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(CaptureDate = toString(toDate(toString((currentTimestamp()), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Book_ID as integer,
		OpicsSpotBook as string,
		AccountingLink as string,
		ProfitCenter as string,
		Base_Currency as string,
		BusinessType as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		Activity as string,
		CaptureDate as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		OpicsLBook as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Book_ID = BOOK_ID,
		OpicsSpotBook = OPICSSPOTBOOK,
		AccountingLink = ACCOUNTINGLINK,
		ProfitCenter = PROFITCENTER,
		Base_Currency = BASE_CURRENCY,
		BusinessType = BUSINESSTYPE,
		BOOK_NAME,
		Activity = ACTIVITY,
		CaptureDate,
		LEGAL_ENTITY,
		LONG_NAME,
		OpicsLBook = OPICSLBOOK,
		Location = LOCATION)) ~> FlatFileDestination
